deploy_unit.out:
# /etc/systemd/system/gtron-deploy.service
[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=java-tron
Group=java-tron
WorkingDirectory=/data/gtron
Environment="HOME=/home/java-tron"
Environment="PATH=/data/go/bin:/home/java-tron/.cargo/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"
Environment="SERVICE_NAME=gtron.service"
Environment="RUN_TESTS=1"
ExecStart=/data/gtron/start.sh
TimeoutStartSec=45min

# /etc/systemd/system/gtron-deploy.service.d/99-offline-disk-20260907.conf
[Unit]
# /etc/systemd/system/gtron-deploy.service.d/zz-history-staging-deploy-timeout.conf
[Service]
# A staged reader authenticates its cold history before opening the Wallet API.
# Cover the default 12 h new-release audit, a second 12 h rollback audit,
# and 2 h for tests/build/guard work. A shorter unit can kill recovery.
# For an explicitly longer (up to 24 h) health wait, install a later root-owned
# override and verify the effective TimeoutStartUSec before running deploy.
TimeoutStartSec=26h

# /etc/systemd/system/gtron-deploy.timer
[Unit]
Description=Check go-tron master every minute

[Timer]
OnBootSec=2min
OnUnitActiveSec=1min
Unit=gtron-deploy.service
Persistent=true

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

# /etc/systemd/system/gtron-deploy.timer.d/99-offline-disk-20260907.conf
[Unit]
